(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HANCHATE SANJEEVKUMAR)

Learned counsel for respondent No.2 submitted that the very same claimant who is appellant before this Court has preferred another appeal in MFA No.20593/2013, which was disposed of in Lok Adalat on 14.01.2015.
Hence, this appeal is amounts to duplication of claim in view of settlement of claim in appeal in MFA No.20593/2013, which was filed by the very same claimant.
Consequently, this appeal does not survive for consideration.
